html:
JDass Corp continues to strengthen its role in Canada’s construction and infrastructure sector with the participation of Dass Rebar and Dass Metal at The Buildings Show 2025, held December 3–5 at the Metro Toronto Convention Centre. The event brought together Canada’s building industry, connecting developers, engineers, contractors, and project partners involved in housing, commercial development, and public infrastructure across Ontario.

About The Buildings Show 2025

The Buildings Show is Canada’s largest event dedicated to the built environment. Hosted annually in Toronto, the show brings together professionals from construction, real estate development, infrastructure, design, and manufacturing.

The event serves as a platform for networking, learning, and sharing insights on construction standards, building materials, and industry trends shaping Canada’s future. For suppliers and manufacturers like Dass Rebar and Dass Metal, The Buildings Show is an opportunity to connect directly with decision-makers and contribute to conversations that influence Canada’s construction landscape.

Dass Metal at The Buildings Show 2025

Dass Metal participated in The Buildings Show as a Canadian manufacturer of engineered steel studs, tracks, and metal framing systems. We supply metal framing products to contractors and developers across Ontario, supporting residential, commercial, and institutional construction projects.

The team engaged with developers, engineers, and contractors to discuss project collaboration and construction planning. Conversations focused on metal framing solutions, engineered steel products, and manufacturing processes that align with Canadian building standards. Dass Metal’s products are CSSBI certified and designed to support accuracy, consistency, and performance on site.

Dass Metal’s presence at the show reflected its role as a manufacturing partner that supports both large-scale developments and smaller commercial projects. From production through delivery, the company focuses on meeting project timelines while maintaining product consistency and structural reliability.

JDass Corp

JDass Corp is a Canadian, multi-industry company headquartered in Vaughan, Ontario. The organization operates across construction materials, metals manufacturing, hospitality, real estate development, retail, and industrial services. Its structure allows different divisions to support large and complex projects through reliable manufacturing, logistics, and project coordination.

Within the construction sector, JDass Corp supports builders and developers through Dass Rebar and Dass Metal. These divisions focus on reinforcing steel and metal framing systems, both of which are essential components of modern residential, commercial, and infrastructure construction. By operating under a single corporate structure, JDass Corp is able to align manufacturing standards, quality control, and delivery expectations across projects of varying scale.

Our Brands Include:

Dass Metal Products, Dass Rebar, Quick Scrap Metal, Mississauga Convention Centre, Food World Supermarket, Shanty Bay Golf Club, Hotel EST, Skye Hotel & Residences- Best Western Signature Collection, Meadowvale Apartment Hotel, and The Play Scape.

Looking Ahead in Canadian Construction

The Buildings Show 2025 provided a valuable platform for industry engagement and discussion. Through Dass Rebar and Dass Metal, JDass Corp participated in conversations that shape construction practices across Ontario and Canada.

As construction demand grows in Ontario and Canada, JDass Corp remains focused on supporting projects through reliable manufacturing, consistent standards, and long-term industry involvement.
